meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的演示需求写成一个可在浏览器里运行、可翻页的幻灯片作品:离散的页、渐进显示、热点跳转分支、带可编辑演讲备注的演讲者模式。产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 你明确要求做 slideshow 或 HyperFrames 幻灯片时直接开工;若你只是说“presentation”“pitch deck”“把这个页面转成幻灯片”等相邻说法,Claude 会先问一句确认再动手。

say.text: 把这个页面转成幻灯片,保留它原来的视觉和交互。
say.note: 来源是 Figma 链接时会先跑 /figma。

say.text: 在市场那页加个热点,点击跳到更详细的测算分支。
say.note: 热点指向 slideSequences 里的分支序列。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, and a presenter mode with speaker notes. The output is a navigable deck served with `hyperframes present`, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a slideshow or HyperFrames slideshow. For adjacent requests like presentation, pitch deck, or converting a page, Claude pauses and asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn this pitch deck into a HyperFrames slideshow with speaker notes.
say_en.note: You get a navigable deck, not an MP4.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow, keeping its original visuals.
say_en.note: Run /figma first if the source is a Figma URL.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on the market slide that jumps to a deeper sizing branch.
say_en.note: The hotspot targets a slideSequences entry.
